# Oscar Highlights Tailored New Health Products in Texas for 2027 Open Enrollment


November 17, 2026 6:05pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f119d0efa9f2a8b730aba153ee9eb9f9/hioscar/news/2026-11-17_Oscar_Highlights_Tailored_New_Health_Products_in_231.pdf)


*New plan options to serve early retirees, additional protection and convenience*


DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Oscar](http://www.hioscar.com/?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-tx&utm_medium=texas_all_null&utm_term=regional) , one of the fastest-growing insurers in the individual market and part of[Oscar Health](http://www.oscarhealth.com/) (NYSE: OSCR), highlights new additions to its health plan lineup available to Texas individuals, families, and businesses for 2027 Open Enrollment.1


“Texans deserve health coverage that is straightforward, affordable and built for every stage of life,” said Breck Garrett, Texas Market President for Oscar. “Our research shows that four-in-ten (41%) Texans say seeing how a health plan covers their condition, medications, or planned procedures would make them feel more confident in their choice. Oscar offers plans designed around the life stages, health needs and budgets of the people we serve, with predictable costs, personalized support and tools that make it easier to get the care they need.”


Oscar expands its growing product portfolio tailored to life stage, clinical, cultural, and work needs with *[RetireEase](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/retire-ease?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-tx&utm_medium=texas_all_null&utm_term=regional)* . The new plan simplifies the transition from early retirement to Medicare, empowering early retirees to protect their savings with healthcare built around their current needs. Members benefit by staying with trusted doctors and accessing $0 generic medications. It also includes set prices for preventive visits, lab work, physical therapy, heart care, and bone-and-joint care. RetireEase may be a more affordable alternative for individuals leaving employer coverage.


**Supporting members with culturally relevant plans** In Texas, more than[5.7 million people (ages 18-64) speak Spanish at home](https://data.census.gov/table/ACSST1Y2024.S1601?g=040XX00US48) , according to the U.S. Census Bureau. Oscar offers support for Spanish-speaking members with:


- *[Hola Oscar](https://www.hioscar.com/blog/introducing-the-holaoscar-program-going-beyond-the-basics-for-our-spanish)* , a program that provides access to Spanish-speaking providers, customer service, and more.
- *[Buena Salud](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/buena-salud)* offers Spanish communications, Spanish-speaking customer service, and access to Spanish-speaking healthcare providers as well for Texans who receive employer-sponsored coverage through CHOICE Arrangements (Formerly ICHRA)
- *[Oswell](https://www.hioscar.com/es/get-coverage/meet-oswell)* , our first-of-its-kind health AI agent, available in Spanish through the secure Oscar app or member website.


**Affordable bundles, added financial protection** Open Enrollment gives Texans an opportunity to reassess their health care needs and choose plans that support both everyday care and unexpected moments. One-in-three (34%) Texans also report that an unforeseen medical bill after an unexpected event can hurt as much as the event itself.


In response, Oscar partnered with[Allstate Health Solutions](https://www.hioscar.com/for-members/supplemental-plans?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-tx&utm_medium=texas_all_null&utm_term=regional) to add supplemental cash-pay options to any Oscar plan in Texas. These low-cost options can help cover medical bills from accidents, serious illnesses, or hospital stays.


Oscar is also introducing new plans with[dental and vision coverage](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/oscar-vision-dental?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-tx&utm_medium=texas_all_null&utm_term=regional) automatically included. The all-in-one package includes $0 preventive dental checkups, $0 eye exams, and discounted vision benefits.2 Other personalized options for Texans include[HelloMeno](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/hellomeno?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-tx&utm_medium=texas_all_null&utm_term=regional) , which provides a $0 package of menopause treatments, scans, and screenings, as well as other plans providing tailored coverage for members living with[diabetes](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/diabetes-care?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-tx&utm_medium=texas_all_null&utm_term=regional) ,[COPD, asthma](https://www.hioscar.com/for-members/asthma-copd?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-tx&utm_medium=texas_all_null&utm_term=regional) , and[cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome](https://www.hioscar.com/for-members/chronic-care-ckm?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-tx&utm_medium=texas_all_null&utm_term=regional) .3


**CHOICE empowers working Texans** Workers whose employers offer a CHOICE Arrangement can use their monthly contribution to help pay for their individual coverage. CHOICE allows employers to offer competitive benefits with clear, predictable budgets. Employees are empowered with tax-free contributions to easily choose the best plan for them and trusted CHOICE administrators simplify the transition and implementation process.


Employers can enroll their teams at[hioscar.com/for-employers](https://www.hioscar.com/for-employers?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-tx&utm_medium=texas_all_null&utm_term=regional) , or through their broker.


Individuals, families, and employees can sign up for Oscar’s health plans starting Nov. 1, 2026, with coverage beginning on Jan. 1, 2027 by visiting[Healthcare.gov](http://healthcare.gov/) , calling 1-855-672-2788, or speaking with an insurance agent. Anyone shopping for coverage should confirm that their preferred doctor and healthcare system are part of the plan network before enrolling for the upcoming year.


**About Oscar Insurance** Oscar Insurance is one of the largest and fastest-growing health insurers dedicated to the individual market. Oscar serves millions of individuals across the country with innovative products and CHOICE Arrangement solutions (formerly ICHRA) tailored to their life stages, health needs, and budgets. Oscar technology-powered experiences make high-quality care easy to use and feel personal. Oscar is part of Oscar Health, Inc. (NYSE: OSCR). Learn more at[HiOscar.com](http://www.hioscar.com/?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-tx&utm_medium=texas_all_null&utm_term=regional) .
